{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter for completed orders AND exclude QA orders in a single step, avoiding index misalignment
completed_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify counts
num_completed = len(completed_clean)
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding 6 QA orders): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding QA: {num_completed}")
print(f"Number of QA orders: {num_qa}")"}
